pages.text: A diamond is a bright, durable mineral used in advanced equipment. This spotlight is a structured item reference, so JEI should connect the diamond directly to this chapter.$(br2)Diamonds are rare below the surface and are usually found in small veins. Fortune can increase the number recovered from each ore block.

Field note: compare the words Diamond and diamonds with the exact registry identifier minecraft:diamond. Each form should lead back to this entry.$(br2)Keep one diamond as a reference sample before crafting the rest into tools or storage blocks.
